text:
The son will most likely **not prevail**. He is an intended donee beneficiary, but his rights had not vested when the landscaper and owner agreed to redirect payment to the father, so they could still modify the contract without his consent. The owner's payment to the father therefore discharged the owner's duty. The main weakness is that the owner's payment amount did not change, which invites a consideration challenge to the modification.

CONFIDENCE: 70
